epic.title: Reduce CC (Cyclomatic Complexity) to ≤5 for 5 functions across 3 files in src2/.
deliverables: All functions must pass uv run ruff check with no new errors.
All functions must pass find_cc_nested.py verification (CC ≤ 5).

definition_of_done: CC for the 5 target functions is ≤ 5
Refactoring uses guard clauses, early returns, helper extraction, and match/case where appropriate
No dict dispatch or hallucinated helpers are used
try/except blocks remain ≤ 2 total across the 3 files
acceptance_criteria: find_cc_nested.py reports 0 violations across the 3 scoped files
uv run ruff check passes on all 3 files
All existing unit tests pass without regression

cells.criterion: Target functions in src2/agents.py have CC ≤ 5

draft.summary: Refactoring to reduce cyclomatic complexity in agents.py, forecast_store.py, and billing.py. Each file is handled by a separate task in a parallelizable work group utilizing AST-edit.

subtasks.title: Refactor CC in agents.py
subtasks.instruction: Refactor _format_advisory_value (target CC <= 5) and _get_fallback_narrative (target CC <= 5). Use guard clauses, extract smaller helpers for list and dict handling, and use match/case.
subtasks.acceptance: find_cc_nested.py reports CC ≤ 5 for _format_advisory_value and _get_fallback_narrative; ruff check passes

subtasks.title: Refactor CC in forecast_store.py
subtasks.instruction: Refactor _synthesize_and_save_daily_forecast (target CC <= 5) and _extract_trigger_labels (target CC <= 5). Extract inner loops and dict/object branching into small helper methods with CC <= 3. Use match/case where suitable.
subtasks.acceptance: find_cc_nested.py reports CC ≤ 5 for _synthesize_and_save_daily_forecast and _extract_trigger_labels; ruff check passes

subtasks.title: Refactor CC in billing.py
subtasks.instruction: Refactor validate_promo_code (target CC <= 5). Use guard clauses and return early for invalid states rather than deeply nesting the successful path.
subtasks.acceptance: find_cc_nested.py reports CC ≤ 5 for validate_promo_code; ruff check passes

risks: Breaking existing logic by incorrect match/case implementation.
Extraction of helpers might introduce missing imports if not done carefully.

strategy.how_to_fix: For agents.py: Refactor _format_advisory_value by splitting the list and dict cases into smaller private helpers `_format_list` and `_format_dict`, and use match/case instead of isinstance chains. Refactor _get_fallback_narrative by using early return guard clauses and match/case for type checks. For forecast_store.py: Refactor _synthesize_and_save_daily_forecast by extracting inner loops/conditions into a helper function. Refactor _extract_trigger_labels by using match/case on the event type (dict vs object) and extracting the trigger extraction logic. For billing.py: Refactor validate_promo_code by utilizing early returns / guard clauses for invalid states instead of nested if-else structures.
